title: 第2幕脱离常识世界的开端第3幕退出或者战斗
content_zh:
第2幕 脱离常识世界的开端
“May－all－your－wish－come－true。恭喜您成为天神系统的正式玩家，本终端已经和您绑定，从这一刻起，用您的努力来取悦主神吧。
我是您的特别助理O1，如果您有任何要求均可以向我提出。
您的异能检测及生成工作已经准备完毕。您有24小时的时间调整心态来接受检测，当您准备好迈向成神之路后就请联系我吧，我将竭诚为您服务，希望您能够尽快做出决定。”
听着手机中传出的电话挂断的嘟嘟声，吞了吞口水，邢辰不禁自言自语的喃喃起来：“开玩笑的吧……”
这到底是怎么一回事？邢辰完全不能理解，就算是恶作剧也没有这种玩法吧！？骗钱的骗子？可是这样又能骗什么？连卡都没有还能骗话费？或者是中奖诈骗？就算是买房退税也比那什么天神系统靠谱点吧！？还什么生成异能，搞笑呢！？或者是那女孩打来的恶作剧？这也不怎么靠谱啊！
“听对方的意思似乎是要我再打回去……要不……试试？只要小心点应该没事的吧……”邢辰如是想着。
按照他的想法，反正这部手机本来就是他捡回来的，而且也没装卡，就算是打回去个电话也不会损失什么电话费。如果对方真的是诈骗的话，邢辰已经打定主意一旦对方有什么地方提到需要让他交钱，那他就立刻挂断，只要我不上当还有什么好怕的？
最终，一向怕麻烦的邢辰这一次却是在丝毫不清楚这件事情严重性的情况下做出了决定——打回去问个清楚！
熟悉了一下手机的操作，邢辰很快就找到了刚刚打过来的那个号码，不过，这个号码却是颇为古怪——只有一个0！
“难道说这部手机使用的不是一般网络！？”
惊讶的看着手机上赫然显示出的孤零零一个0，邢辰再次陷入沉思之中，出现了如此怪异的事件确实让他有些惊讶——一般的手机网络是绝不会有这种号码的，就算真的有也不会是他这种档次的人所能接触的。
如果说这个摆在他面前的神秘事物是一栋鬼屋之类可以直观看到感觉到的东西的话，那么以邢辰不愿意招惹麻烦的性格百分之一百会绕道而行，相较于鬼屋里面到底会有什么东西的好奇心而言，他还是更加觉得安全第一。
但是此时的情况却有些特别，一来因为女友的事情邢辰的心神早已混乱，变得容易冲动起来；二来毕竟只是一通电话，天知道电话那头是在北平还是北极，这就让他没有一丝危险的现实感，只觉得难道电话里面还能冒出来一只鬼不成？
就这么着，邢辰鬼使神差的用他的手指重重的按下了拨出键，没有任何等待时间，几乎是刚刚按下键的瞬间那边便已经接通了。
“欢迎您使用天神系统，由于玩家为初次登陆，接下来本终端将会对您的体质进行系统分析以确定是否可以承受进化异能的变异，如果成功，系统将会为您生成合适的异能进化方案。如果失败，非常抱歉，那意味着您的天赋不足以开启异能，您只能以普通人的能力在天神游戏中努力。
那么，祝您成功！现在开始分析……”
一通突兀的话语之后，电话中充满诱惑的女声已然不再说话，只留下屏幕上“分析中”的字样以及惊愕得说不出话来的邢辰。
“分析完成，确认玩家体质符合异能者条件，开始生成进化方案。”
“进化方案生成完毕，开始执行进化。”

随着那诱惑的女声话音落地，邢辰只觉得眼前猛然闪过一阵白光，接着脑袋似乎被什么猛的撞了下般的一沉，便躺倒在地上不省人事了。
而此时手机中奇怪的声音并未由于邢辰的倒下而停止，反而愈发的怪异起来。
“进化方案生成结束，用户异能成功激活，错误……异能激活未授权，发送错误报告。
报告发送中……未知错误404，服务器无法连接……重新发送报告……未知错误404，服务器无法连接……重新发送报告……未知错误404，服务器无法连接……
紧急对策512启动，本地网络连接中……连接成功……信息搜索中……信息搜索完成……开始信息校对……信息校对完成……报告发送失败原因分析为用户未注册……
对策101启动，使用人界终端ID发送……信息发送成功。”
…………
“这……是什么地方？”
当邢辰终于从昏迷之中醒了过来之后惊愕的发现自己竟然来到了一个完全陌生的地方。这里是一个四四方方的密封房间，房间的四周是科幻片中经常出现的白色软包墙壁，完全看不到门和窗户，而正中央则颇为科幻的漂浮着一个圆滚滚的白色光球，和他知道的任何一种科技产品都格格不入。
显然这里不可能是什么医院，反倒像是科幻电影中那些进行邪恶实验的研究所，眼下这种诡异的环境让邢辰不由得紧张起来，不由的吞了吞口水：
“好吧，如果是恶作剧的话我承认他们做的很成功……但如果不是的话……”
对于邢辰所联想到的另外一种可能很多人都非常的熟悉，结合着自己之前拿到手机后的诡异遭遇，他有理由怀疑自己是不是赶上了时下最流行的穿越大军，来到了《杀戮都市》、《无限恐怖》之类的主神世界中——这环境的确很像是无限流的主神房间啊！
很快邢辰的猜测就得到了验证——另外一个人很科幻的出现在了他的面前，而且这个人邢辰怎么看都觉得眼熟。
“是你！？掉手机的那个女孩！？”
“啊？！你是……刚才那个人？你怎么会在天神空间里！？”
邢辰张了张嘴感觉有些发苦，隐隐对自己之所以会出现在这里有了一个猜测：“天神空间？你知道我们是在哪里？”
脸上还留着泪痕的女孩几次张口想要说什么却没有说出来，最后只是一脸苦涩的点了点头。
“那么说，我之所以会在这里是不是和我捡到的你那个手机有关？”
女孩摇了摇头：“我不知道……我真的什么都不知道……我甚至不知道为什么自己刚刚离开却又回来了这个该死的地方！”
就在这时，一个空灵而富有磁性的声音突然响起：

“原因很简单，犯了错误必然需要收到惩罚！至于你，凡人，你只不过是因为那个女人的错误而受到牵连的可怜虫罢了。”
content_en:
Act 2 The beginning of departure from the world of common sense
"May-all-your-wish-come-true. Congratulations on becoming an official player of the God System. This terminal has been bound to you. From this moment on, use your efforts to please the Lord God.
I am your special assistant O1, if you have any requests you can make them to me.
Your ability detection and generation work is now complete. You have 24 hours to adjust your mentality to take the test. When you are ready to take the road to becoming a god, please contact me. I will serve you wholeheartedly and hope you can make a decision as soon as possible. "
Listening to the beep of the phone hanging up, Xing Chen swallowed his saliva and couldn't help but mutter to himself: "Are you kidding..."
What is going on? Xing Chen couldn't understand it at all. Even if it was a prank, it couldn't be played like this! ? A liar trying to steal money? But what can be deceived like this? I don’t even have a card but can I still cheat on phone bills? Or is it a lottery scam? Even the tax rebate for buying a house is more reliable than that Tianshen system! ? It's so funny to generate superpowers! ? Or was it a prank from the girl? This is not very reliable!
"It sounds like the other party wants me to call back... How about... try? As long as you're careful, it should be fine..." Xing Chen thought.
According to his thinking, he had picked up this phone anyway, and it didn't have a card installed. Even if he made a call back, he wouldn't lose any money on the phone bill. If the other party is really a fraud, Xing Chen has already made up his mind that once the other party mentions that he needs to pay money, he will hang up immediately. As long as I don't fall for it, what else do I have to worry about?
In the end, Xing Chen, who was always afraid of trouble, made a decision this time without knowing the seriousness of the matter at all - call back and ask for clarification!
After getting familiar with the operation of the mobile phone, Xing Chen quickly found the number he had just called. However, this number was quite weird - there was only one 0!
"Could it be that this phone is not using a normal network!?"
Looking at the solitary 0 displayed on the phone in surprise, Xing Chen fell into deep thought again. He was a little surprised that such a strange incident occurred - ordinary mobile phone networks would never have such a number, and even if it did exist, it would not be accessible to people of his level.
If the mysterious thing in front of him is something that can be seen and felt intuitively, such as a haunted house, then Xing Chen's character of not wanting to cause trouble will 100% take a detour. Compared to his curiosity about what is in the haunted house, he still feels that safety comes first.
But the situation at this time was a bit special. Firstly, Xing Chen's mind was already confused because of his girlfriend's affairs, and he became easily impulsive. Secondly, after all, it was just a phone call. God knows whether the other end of the phone call was in Peiping or the North Pole. This left him with no sense of dangerous reality. He only thought that there could be a ghost coming out of the phone?
Just like that, Xing Chen accidentally pressed the dial button with his finger. Without any waiting time, the call was connected almost as soon as he pressed the button.
"Welcome to use the God system. Since this is the first time you log in, this terminal will conduct a systematic analysis of your physique to determine whether you can withstand the mutation of evolutionary abilities. If successful, the system will generate a suitable ability evolution plan for you. If it fails, I am very sorry, which means that your talent is not enough to activate the abilities, and you can only work hard in the God game with the abilities of ordinary people.
Well, I wish you success! Let’s start analyzing now…”
After the sudden words, the seductive female voice on the phone stopped speaking, leaving only the words "under analysis" on the screen and Xing Chen, who was stunned and speechless."The analysis is completed, it is confirmed that the player's physique meets the conditions for a superpower, and the evolution plan will be generated."
"The evolution plan is generated and evolution begins."
As the seductive female voice spoke, Xing Chen felt a flash of white light suddenly flash in front of his eyes, and then his head sank as if something had hit him hard, and he lay down on the ground unconscious.
At this time, the strange sounds on the phone did not stop because of Xing Chen's collapse, but became increasingly weird.
"The evolution plan generation is completed, the user's ability is successfully activated, error...the ability activation is not authorized, and an error report is sent.
Report is being sent...Unknown error 404, server cannot be connected...Resend report...Unknown error 404, server cannot be connected...Resend report...Unknown error 404, server cannot be connected...
Emergency countermeasure 512 started, local network connection... connection successful... information search in progress... information search completed... information proofreading started... information proofreading completed... report sending failure reason analyzed was that the user was not registered...
Countermeasure 101 is activated, using the human world terminal ID to send... the message is sent successfully. "
…………
"What...is this place?"
When Xing Chen finally woke up from his coma, he was shocked to find that he had arrived in a completely unfamiliar place. This was a square, sealed room. The room was surrounded by white soft-walled walls that often appeared in science fiction films. There were no doors or windows at all. In the center, there was a round white ball of light floating in a rather sci-fi style. It was incompatible with any technological product he knew.
Obviously this couldn't be a hospital, but rather like those research institutes that conduct evil experiments in science fiction movies. This strange environment made Xing Chen couldn't help but become nervous, and he couldn't help but swallowed his saliva:
"Okay, if it was a prank, I admit they were successful...but if not..."
Many people are very familiar with the other possibility that Xing Chen thought of. Combined with the strange experience he had after getting the mobile phone, he has reason to doubt whether he has caught up with the most popular time-traveling army and came to the world of the Lord God such as "Slaughter City" and "Infinite Horror" - this environment is indeed very similar to the Lord God Room of Infinite Flow!
Soon Xing Chen's guess was verified - another person appeared in front of him, and this person looked familiar to Xing Chen.
"Is it you!? The girl who dropped the phone!?"
"Ah?! Are you...that person just now? How come you are in the god space!?"
Xing Chen opened his mouth and felt a little bitter. He had a vague guess as to why he appeared here: "God space? Do you know where we are?"
The girl with tears on her face opened her mouth several times to say something but did not say anything. In the end, she just nodded with a bitter look on her face.
"So, does the reason why I'm here have something to do with your cell phone I picked up?"
The girl shook her head: "I don't know... I really don't know anything... I don't even know why I just left but came back to this damn place!"
At this moment, an ethereal and magnetic voice suddenly sounded:
"The reason is simple. If you make a mistake, you must be punished! As for you, mortal, you are just a poor person who was implicated because of that woman's mistake."
